def factor_range_pressure_smoothed_tail_skew(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    # primary mechanism: 60-day cycle range pressure
    buy_pressure = (close - low).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (high - close).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (high - low).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    range_pressure = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    # mutate modifier: smooth the tail-skew fragility measure
    ret = close.pct_change()
    skew = ret.rolling(60, min_periods=30).skew()
    skew_smooth = skew.rolling(10, min_periods=5).mean()
    neg_skew = np.clip(-skew_smooth, 0.0, 1.0)
    scale = 1.0 - 0.3 * neg_skew
    factor = range_pressure * scale
    df_copy["factor_range_pressure_smoothed_tail_skew"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_pressure_smoothed_tail_skew"]
description: Preserves the parent's core 60-day cycle range-pressure mechanism, which identifies accumulation/distribution phase by close position within the trailing high-low range. Mutates the lightweight tail-skew attenuation modifier by smoothing the 60-day return skew with a 10-day moving average. This reduces day-to-day noise in the fragility scale, targeting improved IC and ICIR stability while retaining RankIC, RankICIR, MI, and the raw payoff structure with cross-sectional transform none.
